verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs confirm a real integrations catalog with individual guides (Jira, JumpCloud, ClickUp, FreeAgent) and general claims of 'seamless integrations across security frameworks' and 'pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows,' supporting ticketing and identity connections plus ingestion/webhooks for custom data. However, the evidence pack lacks documentation of cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure), code hosting (GitHub/GitLab), or MDM-specific integrations, and never states integrations use read-only scopes. Missing for 10: explicit cloud/code-hosting/MDM integration docs, documented read-only/least-privilege scope model, and independent verification of the full catalog breadth.
